fieldValues.title: Tree and agent-index resources over MCP, with a descent hook on container members
fieldValues.summary: An agent reading a repository over MCP alone could not descend past depth one: the recursion and the orientation index existed in srs-repository but were reachable only through the CLI. This unit adds them as MCP resources and stamps a sectionContainerId descent hook onto container members — an adapter-only change over existing services.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/966. Three resources: srs://<repoId>/tree (tree_service::build_tree with depth and cycle pruning from auto-detected roots), srs://<repoId>/tree/{instanceId} (same service, single root; also a resource template), srs://<repoId>/agent-index (agent_index_service::build_agent_index, AgentIndex verbatim). ResolvedMember gains sectionContainerId, the same key NavigationNode already carries, stamped from the nav service's section_containers_by_root map made pub(crate) rather than duplicated; absent, not null, when a member roots nothing. Serves the zero-context-agent acceptance test in RFC-042 change H. Capability layering per ADR-037: no new semantics, no CLI change, no WASM binding (these are existing services gaining a second adapter, not a new capability). Gates exit 0: cargo build, test, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, pre-commit hook.
